summary: A zero-token programmatic analysis harness that measures codebase health across six axes (importance, consistency, ergonomics, risk, coverage, quality) and synthesises a scored SCORECARD plus a ROI-ranked improvement plan — all without spending agent tokens unless verdict freshness requires it.

intentions.title: Maintain a living, token-efficient codebase health scorecard
intentions.evidence: quality.mjs aggregates all axes into an A–F grade + 8-dim scorecard; status.mjs orchestrates the full programmatic chain and exits early ('FRESH — 0 agent tokens') when nothing has changed

intentions.title: Identify and rank refactor opportunities by ROI
intentions.evidence: quality.mjs computes impact = importance × severity × defect-history, then divides by effort to rank findings; ergonomics.mjs drives the 'bloat' findings (refactor_worth = excess-tokens × churn × separability)

intentions.title: Detect structural drift without human eye — naming, layering, duplication
intentions.evidence: consistency.mjs groups files by directory, derives each group's dominant casing/suffix/use-pattern, flags outliers; nearDup() uses Jaccard shingles; layeringRules enforces dependency-direction contracts

intentions.title: Incremental re-judging — only re-spend agent tokens on changed groups
intentions.evidence: consistency.mjs verdict-cache keys each peer-group by a content-hash sig; batches() emits new batch files only for stale groups and pre-populates results/ with cached verdicts for unchanged ones

intentions.title: Prioritise files by objective importance for agent fan-out
intentions.evidence: build-signals.mjs computes prior scores from fan-in (reverse-dep count), churn percentile, seam membership, entrypoint flag, core-dir flag; partitions files into Tier A (agent-scored) vs Tier B (programmatic) batches

intentions.title: Surface god-modules and fragment files that harm agent DX
intentions.evidence: ergonomics.mjs classifies every code file as fragment/ideal/large/bloat using token thresholds tuned to measured repo distribution (median ~1k, p95 ~5.2k); identifies split candidates by refactor_worth

intentions.title: Detect important code with no test presence
intentions.evidence: quality.mjs joins risk-report (testScore, defectDensity) with importance scores and emits 'untested' findings for files with importance ≥50 and testScore <35
